CVE-2007-5137.title: Buffer overflow in the ReadImage function in generic/tkImgGIF.c i ...
CVE-2007-5137.description: Buffer overflow in the ReadImage function in generic/tkImgGIF.c in Tcl (Tcl/Tk) 8.4.13 through 8.4.15 allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code via multi-frame interlaced GIF files in which later frames are smaller than the first.  NOTE: this issue is due to an incorrect patch for CVE-2007-5378.

CVE-2008-0553.title: Stack-based buffer overflow in the ReadImage function in tkImgGIF ...
CVE-2008-0553.description: Stack-based buffer overflow in the ReadImage function in tkImgGIF.c in Tk (Tcl/Tk) before 8.5.1 allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code via a crafted GIF image, a similar issue to CVE-2006-4484.
